fact: The UN Economic Commission for Africa, working in close collaboration with the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy, announced stakeholder consultations (2-6 June 2026, Brazzaville and Pointe-Noire) with telecom operators, financial institutions, universities and digital economy actors, and a multi-stakeholder workshop on 8 June 2026 including civil society and the private sector, to inform Congo's National Data Governance Strategy; the page is an event announcement dated by the event start.

The Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy, with the UN Economic Commission for Africa and GIZ, held a stakeholder workshop in Brazzaville on 8-9 June 2026 with 60 participants to help draft the National Data Governance Strategy, after an assessment mission of 2-6 June consulting 21 institutions from government, regulators, academia, the private sector, civil society and development partners.
